cmd:
date -u; TZ=Europe/Kyiv date
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/data
echo ---next_expected; python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('model_next_expected.json'));print(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False)[:1500])" 2>&1 | head -20
echo ---queue; cat _ai_pending_models.json | tr -d '\n '; echo
KEY=$(grep -h '^GEMINI_API_KEY=' ../.env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"' | tr -d "'")
echo ---models; curl -s "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?pageSize=200&key=$KEY" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
if 'error' in d: print('ERR',d['error'].get('code'),d['error'].get('message','')[:150])
else:
    n=[m['name'].replace('models/','') for m in d.get('models',[]) if 'generateContent' in m.get('supportedGenerationMethods',[])]
    print([x for x in n if 'flash' in x and 'image' not in x and 'tts' not in x and 'live' not in x and 'audio' not in x])
"
